title: InsightCandidate
description: HER output. Deep sensemaking from DreamSeeds — chiddush extraction. HER may distill meaning but resonance is not evidence.

derived_from_seed_ids.description: Which DreamSeeds this insight was extracted from. Min 1.

insight_sentence.description: The insight in one sentence. Precise. HER's best distillation of what is genuinely new here (chiddush).

source_refs.description: Original source pointers inherited or refined from seeds.

resonance.description: Why this matters emotionally, structurally, or aesthetically. Not an argument — a reading.

possible_use.description: Where this insight might be useful if it turns out to be true or valid.

uncertainty.description: What HER is not sure about. What might make this insight wrong or irrelevant.

evidence_needed.description: What evidence would make this insight stronger or weaker. Handed to HAL as input.

claim_status.description: Always CANDIDATE. InsightCandidates are not claims.

actor.description: Always HER. Only HER emits InsightCandidates.
